title: gemba-onramp-standup-orchidanalytics-2029-06-21
body:
Purpose: quick Gemba-style standup at customer site cadence review. Goal = surface micro-blockers, confirm next 72h runway, and decide whether to request Dedicated burst or fall back to hosted variant.

Attendees (onsite + remote): Ava (lead SE), Rohan (field eng), Lena (infra), Marcus (solutions eng), Priya (security), Jamal (customer TPM - OrchidAnalytics) + 2 Orchids (data eng + platform).

Agenda:
- 5m: context & current SLOs (latency 95p target 220ms for chat flows; throughput target 120 req/s)
- 15m: status by track (infra, model serving, data, security)
- 10m: blockers + decisions
- 10m: actions + owners

Notes:
- Quick recap: Prod-like staging tests completed this week with mixed results. End-to-end 95p latency is 310ms on average (above SLO) during sustained load (80-100rps). Spikes observed at key-switch events (cache miss + KV rehydration).

Infra track (Lena):
- VPC peering to Orchids' staging cluster established. Peering route flaps observed at 2029-06-19 03:40 UTC; root cause suspected to be iptables rule rotation on their side. Follow-up: Jamal to coordinate with Orchid infra to prevent nightly rule rotations during tests.
- Autoscaler config: Dedicated pool min=2, max=6. Observed cold-start time for an extra replica ~ 38s (too high). Action: Lena to prod a tuning PR for faster instance boot (INF-1298).
- Suggestion: enable pre-warm warmup pods for predicted load windows. Marcus to draft prewarm schedule prototype.

Model serving track (Rohan):
- KV cache warmup: prefix cache hit rate is 62% in staging (goal 85%). Misses correspond to long-tail user prompts that Orchids send.
- Workaround: we can ship a short-lived prefix-padding policy to boost warmups for top 50 user journeys — low-risk change. Action: Rohan + Jamal to collate top 50 prompt prefixes by EOD 2029-06-22.
- Quantization profile: current model running int8-quant on dedicated, small accuracy regression on hallucination test set (~2% delta). We agreed to pin the model to float16 variant for initial 2-week onramp to avoid customer-visible regressions. PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchid-integ/pull/64

Data & integration track (Marcus):
- Message schema mismatch between Orchid eventing (v2) and our ingest (expecting v1). Caused 7% of requests to be dropped silently. Action: Marcus to push a backward-compatible adapter by 2029-06-24. Linked JIRA: SE-4821.
- Observability: Orchids want token-level cost attribution per feature flag. We suggested a lightweight tag surface that maps feature_flag -> route label. Marcus to prototype and demo next call.

Security & compliance (Priya):
- KMS onboarding: Orchids require HSM-wrapped keys for prod. Private deployment checklist shows 12 items; 4 remain (attestation docs, HSM test keys, vendor contact, key rotation window). Action: Priya to schedule vendor handshake with Orchids on 2029-06-23.
- Cert rotation: staging certs expire 2029-06-28. Must rotate by 2029-06-26 to avoid last-minute outage. Jamal to approve cert CSR today.

Blockers (priority):
1) KV cache warmup rate (impact: latency spikes + cost). Owner: Rohan. ETA: 2029-06-22 for prefix list; 2029-06-25 for rollout.
2) Event schema adapter (impact: 7% dropped requests). Owner: Marcus. ETA: 2029-06-24.
3) Nightly iptables rotations causing peering instability (impact: intermittent failures during tests). Owner: Jamal (Orchid) + Lena. ETA: 2029-06-23 for mitigation window.
4) HSM / KMS attestation docs lag (impact: cannot go to prod-private). Owner: Priya. ETA: 2029-06-26.

Decisions made in meeting:
- Do not enable int8 quantized model for Orchids until after 2-week data review. Default to float16 for initial heavy load.
- Approve short-lived prefix-padding warmup policy. Will be toggled via feature flag for Canary first.
- If KV warmup doesn't reach 80% by 2029-06-25, request a Dedicated burst for two extra replicas to keep latency under SLO while we iterate (Ava to trigger).

Action items (owner / due):
- Rohan: assemble top-50 prompt prefixes and draft prefix-padding config (due 2029-06-22).
- Marcus: implement v2->v1 adapter & add test coverage (SE-4821) (due 2029-06-24).
- Lena: open INF-1298 tuning PR for faster replica readiness; propose prewarm schedule (due 2029-06-23).
- Priya: complete KMS attestation checklist, schedule vendor call with Orchid security (due 2029-06-26).
- Ava: prep Dedicated burst request template and threshold triggers; if triggered, send escalation to sales-eng + infra (due 2029-06-25).
- Jamal (Orchid): approve cert CSR + pause nightly rotating iptables jobs for staging window (due 2029-06-22).

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: if adapter rollout delayed, 7% of requests will be dropped leading to customer-visible missing suggestions. Mitigation: temporary retry shim in ingest that normalizes event schema. Marcus to include retries in adapter PR.
- Risk: HSM delays block prod cutover. Mitigation: propose a short-term KMS proxy with audit logging until HSM attestation completes. Priya to draft acceptance criteria.

Parking lot / follow-ups:
- Explore routing policy to send tail-heavy sessions to hosted fallback model to save cost without impacting median latency.
- Add synthetic tests for certificate rotation to CI to prevent last-minute expiry surprises.
- Review billing meter mapping once feature flag tagging is in place.

Next check-in: Standup on 2029-06-23 16:00 UTC (sync same week) + war room if KV warmup < 75% on 2029-06-25.

Random notes / notes-to-self:
- Jamal is keen on seeing token-level dashboards next week — prioritize demo.
- Consider pushing a small canary to 10% user traffic to validate prefix-padding impact on both latency and quality metrics before wider rollout.

Meeting adjourned at 45 minutes.

Attachments / quick refs:
- Staging perf snapshot (http link added to Confluence runbook)
- INF-1298 tuning checklist in PR comments
- SE-4821 adapter working branch
